text:
No, the conviction should not be reversed. Shipping the sub-strength lot hastened the death of a terminally ill patient, which makes it a legal cause even though the patient would have died anyway. The president knew the lot was below strength and sent it to cancer patients who depended on it, which can supply the malice murder requires, so the team note's "merely a regulatory offense" view understates what he knew. Whether his mental state meets the jurisdiction's malice standard, rather than only recklessness, is the main point on which the answer could turn.

CONFIDENCE: 65
